Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. Inclusão A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades. Partnering closely with distributor sales teams and key customers, they will identify opportunities, close executional gaps, and build long‑term, value‑driven relationships across São Paulo and the broader Southeast region. This role is critical to advancing Zamora's ambition of building a best‑in‑class route-to-market and execution model in Brazil. Accompany the distributor's team in top accounts to guarantee strategic alignment. Identify execution gaps and immediately work with distributors and outlets to correct them. Ensure all points of sale are aligned with Zamora’s brand positioning and premium image. Distributor & Sales Team Development Work hand in hand with distributor sales teams, acting as a field coach and execution driver to generate sell out. Implement national and regional brand programs in the field, ensuring perfect execution at store level. Lead tastings, bartender activations, menu placements, cocktail programs and in‑store promotions. Be responsible for the quality of execution of key platforms like L43 Puro, Carajillo and Limão. Market Intelligence & Opportunity Detection Act as Zamora’s market radar in Rio. Identify trends, new hot spots, key bartenders, emerging venues and new retail opportunities. Monitor competitors’ activities, pricing, promotions and visibility. Provide regular feedback to the Area Director and Marketing Team with actionable insights. Relationship Building Build strong and trusted relationships with: Distributor management and sales teams Bartenders, bar managers, store owners and buyers Key influencers Become a recognized Zamora representative in the Rio trade. Develop mid- and long‑term partnerships that secure Zamora’s presence in priority accounts. Reporting & Performance Tracking KPIs will be measured in 4 pillars: Business (eg. volume sold on On trade Channel) Commercial Execution (# stores with perfect execution) Promotion (eg, number of trainings) Digital (Eg. reports/ community built) Provide structured reports with photos, insights and recommendations. Help to ensure activities and investments are properly documented and evaluated. title: Carrier Sales
description: About Carolina Logistics At Carolina Logistics, we are a fast-growing international freight forwarder committed to delivering integrated logistics solutions that connect businesses around the world. We believe in the power of teamwork, innovation, and talent development to continue expanding our global operations. Position Overview We are looking for a highly experienced Ground Freight Pricing Specialist to join our commercial and operations team. This role will be fully focused on terrestrial/ground transportation pricing, supporting domestic and cross-border operations through strategic rate analysis, carrier management, and competitive quotation development. Your mission will be to build accurate, competitive, and profitable pricing solutions while maintaining strong relationships with carriers and internal stakeholders in a fast‑paced logistics environment. Key Responsibilities Prepare and manage pricing quotations for domestic and cross-border ground freight services. Analyze transportation costs, carrier rates, market trends, and margins to ensure profitability and competitiveness. Negotiate and maintain relationships with trucking carriers, brokers, and transportation providers. Monitor market fluctuations, fuel impacts, capacity trends, and pricing updates within the ground freight sector. Support Sales and Key Account Management teams with pricing strategies and operational insights. Maintain and update pricing databases, routing guides, and internal quotation tools. Collaborate closely with operations teams to ensure pricing feasibility and service alignment. Identify opportunities to optimize costs, improve pricing processes, and increase operational efficiency. Ensure timely responses to RFQs and customer pricing requests. Requirements 5+ years of experience in Pricing within the logistics, transportation, or freight forwarding industry. Strong expertise in ground freight / terrestrial transportation pricing. Experience handling domestic and cross-border trucking operations. Upper-intermediate to advanced English, with the ability to communicate effectively with carriers, suppliers, and international teams. Strong understanding of freight costs, market dynamics, incoterms, margins, and quotation structures. Advanced analytical and negotiation skills with strong attention to detail. Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (formulas, data analysis, pricing tables, reporting). Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for a proactive, analytical, and results-driven professional with deep knowledge of ground transportation pricing and carrier management. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in dynamic logistics environments, enjoys problem solving, and contributes strategic ideas that strengthen our competitiveness and operational performance. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Crude Oil Market Analyst
description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top‑tier intelligence through user‑friendly platforms. Our team of over 700 experts from 35+ countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting‑edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. Your future position Kpler’s Oil & Chemicals business unit is looking for a Crude Oil Market Analyst with a strong data and market analysis background. In this role, you will own, validate, and scale the core crude oil dataset for the booming Latin American market. This is a highly impactful, hybrid position: you will be the guardian of our regional data integrity, ensuring Kpler has the most accurate crude oil tracking repository. You will spend your time balanced between hands‑on data manipulation and real‑time market reporting. This role sits right at the intersection of data and insights—you will monitor live terminal data, vessel movements, and refinery activity across the LATAM market. Collaborating closely with Data Ops, Product Engineering, and Commercial teams, you will turn complex datasets into fast, factual market updates ("Pulses") that power the decision‑making of the world’s top commodity traders and oil majors. Your mission is to: Monitor and validate crude oil data daily (flows, inventories, refinery activity) to ensure accuracy and consistency Analyse cargo movements, supply/demand dynamics, and freight trends across the Americas Identify anomalies, gaps, and inconsistencies in datasets and resolve or elevate as needed Support the production of quick market insights, commentary, and ad‑hoc analysis Work with large, complex datasets to extract trends and actionable insights Maintain and enhance datasets related to crude oil markets Contribute to data quality improvements and workflow enhancements Collaborate with Data, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams Support client queries, presentations, and product demonstrations where needed Respond to internal and external data requests in a timely manner Manage KPIs and OKRs, provide insights for improvement, and support product development Experience & Background Experience in crude oil or petroleum market analysis, with a strong understanding of trade flows, supply/demand balances, freight, and refining basics Understanding of Latin American crude markets, with knowledge of regional asset dynamics Proficiency in SQL and Excel Experience working with large or complex datasets Fluent in English, Spanish, and/or Portuguese (written and spoken) Python—highly regarded Familiarity with geospatial / vessel tracking data Experience engaging with clients or supporting commercial teams Experience contributing to product or data improvement initiatives Strong data validation and validation skill with ability to investigate and troubleshoot data issues Ability to seamlessly connect granular data points with broad global market context and vice versa Ownership of day‑to‑day work and accountability for output Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment Collaborative and team‑oriented Proactive in identifying issues and suggesting improvements Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Energy, or related field. Graduate degree is a plus but not required Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work‑environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Documentação e Padronização : Manter documentação técnica atualizada, padrões de nomenclatura de recursos, tagging strategy e guias de uso dos módulos de IaC para as equipes de desenvolvimento. title: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform
description: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform Staff Software Engineer – Digital Experience Platform (DXP) About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and beyond — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. We combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. The Digital Experience Platform (DXP) is Nubank’s AI-first platform ecosystem designed to radically compress our product development workflow from concept to production. Today, building “Magic App”-quality experiences in our Backend-Driven Content (BDC) stack takes ~49 working days and ~24 handoff-heavy steps — DXP exists to close this Creation Gap and Workflow Gap by making AI-native tooling the default way we design, build, and ship experiences. We are building four core products: DXP Studio (an AI-powered creation environment that turns Figma designs into production-ready BDC code), DXP Dictionary (the curated knowledge base that makes AI agents “Nu-aware”), DXP Spec Protocol (our vendor-agnostic abstraction layer), and DXP Workflow (an orchestration platform for hybrid human + AI agent teams across the product lifecycle). As a Staff Software Engineer – DXP , you will be the technical leader and multiplier for this initiative: shaping the architecture of an AI-native platform, driving critical decisions across the Figma-to-BDC pipeline and agent orchestration, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to prove value and scale the platform company-wide. We’re looking for someone genuinely addicted to AI — who obsessively explores new models, agent frameworks, and AI-powered tools, and can turn that passion into leverage for thousands of Nubank engineers. You’ll be responsible for Architect the DXP Studio pipeline: Design and lead the end-to-end architecture for the Figma → DXP Spec → BDC code generation flow, ensuring vendor-agnostic abstractions (DXP Spec Protocol), NuDS component fidelity, and production-ready output quality. Lead AI agent integration & orchestration: Define how AI agents (codegen, QA, design-mapping, etc.) are composed, executed, and supervised inside DXP; drive decisions on LLM provider abstraction, context-assembly strategies, MCP tool surfaces, and execution environments. Own the DXP Dictionary and knowledge architecture: Architect the knowledge base that turns generic AI into Nubank-aware agents — how NuDS specs, tokens, canonical patterns and domain knowledge are ingested, structured, and consumed by generation and validation pipelines. Drive cross-platform integration: Lead the technical integration model with NuDS (component catalog & tokens), BDC/Core (patterns & services), HPP (widget / homepage infrastructure), and App Excellence (observability & quality metrics), defining clear contracts that position DXP as an orchestrator on top of existing platforms. Establish quality-at-generation-time: Design automated quality enforcement for generated experiences — NuDS compliance, token correctness, accessibility rules, structural integrity, golden tests — so governance happens by default at generation time, not via manual post-hoc review. Set technical strategy and roadmap: Contribute to the 6–18 month technical strategy for DXP, translating strategic bets into executable plans, identifying architectural risks and trade-offs between POCs and long-term scalability. Multiply engineering excellence: Mentor engineers within DXP and partner teams (NuDS, BDC, Mobile Platform), lead design reviews and RFCs, and raise the bar for AI-augmented development practices across Nubank. We are looking for a person who has Must Have Genuine obsession with AI tools and workflows — deep, hands‑on, daily experience with LLMs, AI agents and modern AI‑powered dev tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, custom agents, MCP servers); you are the person who has tried new tools before others even ask about them. Strong software architecture skills , with experience designing multi‑component platform systems that integrate AI/LLM capabilities into production workflows. Deep understanding of design‑to‑code pipelines, design systems or component‑driven UI development , ideally bridging design tooling (e.g., Figma) and code generation. Practical experience with AI/LLM integration in software products : prompt engineering, agent orchestration, context management, RAG architectures and/or MCP tool development. Proven ability to lead cross‑functional technical initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders, driving alignment and delivery in ambiguous environments. Excellent communication skills , translating complex architectural decisions into clear narratives for Product, Design and senior leadership. Product‑minded mindset , balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery — comfortable proving value via POCs before scaling platform capabilities. Experience with Nubank’s stack or similar patterns : BDC (Backend‑Driven Content), and broader mobile/frontend ecosystems. Will be a Plus Experience with Flutter at the intersection of design systems and code generation. Hands‑on experience building or integrating AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Cursor) into team workflows. Familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms , agent farms or multi‑agent systems. Understanding of analytical architectures , experimentation platforms, feature flags and progressive rollout strategies for generated experiences. Prior experience productizing internal developer tools or platforms that serve large engineering orgs. Contributions to open‑source AI developer tools or active presence in the AI‑for‑developers community. Location for this opportunity This role can be based in one of the following hubs: For global, multi‑location roles like this, our benefits package is competitive in each country and generally includes: Competitive compensation and the opportunity of earning equity at Nu Health / Medical Insurance Life Insurance (and AD&D where applicable) Extended maternity and paternity leaves Nucleo – our learning platform of courses NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program Paid time off and local holidays Retirement / savings plans (e.g., 401(k), HSA/FSA in the US; country‑specific plans elsewhere) Work‑from‑home allowance Relocation assistance package, if applicable Details for each location will be shared during the process, aligned with local regulations and practices. If you want to define how an AI‑native bank designs and ships product experiences — turning agentic workflows, design systems and code generation into everyday tools for hundreds of teams — we’d love to hear from you. #J-18808-Ljbffr

A team player that can manage and work into a cross functional team that are geographically separated. Aware of social and cultural differences and the need to respect all. Good knowledge of the economics and operations of telecommunications networks. Strong interpersonal skills and cultural awareness. Job Summary We are seeking an experienced LATAM Indirect Tax Manager to lead and own indirect tax matters across Spanish-speaking Latin American countries, with primary focus on Mexico, Peru, and Chile, and the ability to support additional LATAM countries as the scope evolves. In addition to managing end‑to‑end indirect tax compliance in‑house, the role plays a key part in evolving how indirect tax work is performed by modernizing workflows and embedding tax requirements into financial systems. Success in this role means ensuring high‑quality compliance while proactively driving automation and scalability across the region. The ideal candidate has strong indirect tax technical skills, Big 4 and/or multinational experience, and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders. Responsibilities Indirect tax ownership and advisory Own all indirect tax matters for Mexico, Peru, Chile, and other LATAM countries as assigned, including VAT/IVA, withholding taxes, and other transaction taxes Act as the primary owner for indirect tax positions, risks, and outcomes in scope Oversee electronic invoicing and digital reporting requirements, including Mexico’s CFDI and similar regimes in Chile and Peru Provide clear, practical indirect tax advice to Finance (including Controllership), Accounting, Billing, AP, Legal, IT, and business stakeholders Translate indirect tax requirements into workable business and operational guidance Support new or changing business activities by assessing indirect tax impacts and execution requirements Risk management and audit handling Identify indirect tax risks and operational gaps on an ongoing basis and recommend mitigation actions Lead and manage indirect tax audits, reviews, and tax authority inquiries Coordinate with external advisors for country‑specific filings or audit support while maintaining internal accountability for all responses and documentation Review and challenge audit findings where appropriate and support remediation actions Use audit outcomes to identify process improvements and control enhancements Process transformation and efficiency Drive continuous improvement of indirect tax processes with a focus on efficiency, scalability, and sustainability Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, recurring rework, and reliance on ad‑hoc fixes Leverage automation, tax engines, data, and AI‑enabled tools to improve accuracy, consistency, and cycle time across compliance and audit support activities Work with Finance, IT, and transformation teams to embed indirect tax requirements into upstream systems and processes rather than relying on manual workarounds Support the implementation and ongoing optimization of ERP and tax technology solutions, including Oracle Cloud and indirect tax engines such as Vertex Monitor legislative and regulatory changes and assess whether process or system updates are required Stakeholder collaboration and execution model Partner closely with Finance (including Controllership), Accounting, Legal, IT, Operations, transformation teams, and external advisors Serve as a trusted point of contact for indirect tax matters, communicating clearly in Spanish and English Execute in‑house compliance workflows consistently with agreed processes and standards Qualifications Seven or more years of indirect tax experience, with a focus on Spanish‑speaking LATAM countries Hands‑on experience with in‑house indirect tax compliance preparation, audits, and advisory matters Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to provide clear, practical guidance in complex situations Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex tax concepts in a business setting in Spanish and English Comfortable leveraging automation and AI‑enabled tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in tax processes, including data reconciliation and research Comfortable working with technology, including ERP systems (Oracle Cloud preferred) and tax engines or automation tools (Vertex experience is a plus) Big 4 and/or multinational corporate tax experience preferred Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and self‑motivated, with strong time and project management skills Ability to work effectively across functions in a fast‑paced, global organization Bachelor’s degree in
